GO-2026-5288 (GHSA-9fw6-xgg2-mq9q): a specially built QUIC packet makes a Hysteria server run out of memory when the server's sniffing is on. HyRouter Lite links only the client of github.com/apernet/hysteria/core/v2 (internal/hycore); the database lists the whole module without symbols and no fixed version, so every call into it is reported. Remove this line once a fixed core/v2 is out and in go.mod.
